3. [RARC.5.6.4] Applies the event to working memory (assert /
   retract / TTL update / logical retract).

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__count_frame
idris.note: Another kind's count is untouched by a change confined to one.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__count_remove_lt
idris.note: Removing a live fact strictly lowers its kind's count.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__count_remove_lte
idris.note: Removal never raises a kind's count.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__facts_of_kind_append
idris.note: Facts of a kind distribute over ++.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__frame_append
idris.note: Appending a fact is a change confined to its kind.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__frame_remove
idris.note: Removing a fact is a change confined to its kind.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__frame_trans
idris.note: Frame composes.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__all_facts_of_kind
idris.note: Facts of a kind have that kind.

idris.name: Rarc_5_6_4__frame_pred
idris.note: A change confined to the kinds satisfying a predicate: every other kind's facts are the same list. The single-kind frame is the case of one kind.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__facts_of_kind_retract
idris.note: Retracting ids none of which belongs to a fact of a kind leaves that kind's facts alone.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__counts_by_kind
idris.note: Live-fact count per kind, for run reports.

idris.name: Rarc_5_6_4__frame
idris.note: A change confined to one kind: every other kind's facts are unchanged. What every emit and withdraw satisfies, and what the termination measure's per-stratum locality rests on. Defined beside the working-memory type it is about; the frame lemmas are in Lcyc/Lemmas.idr.

idris.name: Rarc_5_6_4__wm
idris.note: Working memory is the list of live facts, in assertion order. Assert appends, retract removes; TTL update and logical retract are outside the engine (no time, no TMS).

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__count_kind
idris.note: How many live facts of a kind.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__facts_of_kind
idris.note: The live facts of a kind, in assertion order.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__is_live
idris.note: Whether an id is live.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__lookup_fact
idris.note: The live fact with an id, if any.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__remove_exact
idris.note: Retract: remove exactly this fact (id, kind, value all equal). The id alone would do in every reachable state; removing by the whole fact keeps that a consequence rather than an invariant the proofs carry.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_net
idris.note: An input applied to the engine: an adapter assert under the kind's lifecycle, or the retraction of a live fact by id; an id not live is a no-op. Rete/PumpBoundary.idr's events, so the two models share a history.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_4__apply_ttl_assert_elem
idris.note: What a host assert leaves live: live before, or the fact minted.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_4__apply_ttl_net_keeps
idris.note: A data event keeps what is carried: a no-op leaves the net; an assert or the retraction of a live fact, then the cascade.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_4__apply_ttl_retract_sub
idris.note: A host retraction only removes.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_unique
idris.note: An input keeps one live fact per key.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_net_view
idris.note: AN INPUT keeps the view.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__applied_inv
idris.note: Inputs with no pump between them keep the frame invariant.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_net_inv
idris.note: The clause's apply keeps the frame invariant: inputs are not framed and need not be.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__prepare_net_inv
idris.note: A data event prepared is the clause's apply, after the sweep this model runs as the input is consumed; RARC.5.6.3 runs the sweep at the pump's entry instead, and an input retracts nothing.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__prepare_net_unfired
idris.note: And fires nothing.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_tms_net_inv
idris.note: The clause's apply with the cascade keeps the invariant: inputs are not framed and need not be.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_tms_net_unfired
idris.note: The clause's apply fires nothing.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_ttl_net_inv
idris.note: The clause's apply on the clocked network keeps the invariant; the deadline table rides beside.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_ttl_net_unfired
idris.note: And fires nothing.

idris.name: iret_11_3__applied_unfired
idris.note: And keeps every activation unfired.

idris.name: iret_11_3__apply_unfired
idris.note: The clause's assert and retract on working memory create no fired activation.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__applied
idris.note: INPUTS APPLIED WITH NO PUMP BETWEEN THEM: a hundred asserts, say, then one pump. The canonical cadence ([LFST.9.2.1]) pumps after each; this one lets the activations accumulate. The definition is the clause's apply, iterated.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__applied_view
idris.note: The clause's apply, iterated with no pump between, keeps the view.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_net_ordered
idris.note: AN INPUT keeps the order.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__remove_exact_absent
idris.note: Removing a fact not live changes nothing.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__remove_exact_elem_fwd
idris.note: A live fact other than the removed one survives the removal.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__remove_exact_elem_inv
idris.note: A fact of working memory less a fact was live and is not that fact.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_g
idris.note: An input with the set beside it.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_g_fst
idris.note: The ghost's input is the model's.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_sound
idris.note: AN INPUT keeps the ghost sound.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_ttl_net_clock
idris.note: The clause's assert and retract move no clock: the sample is the loop's.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_6__input_timed
idris.note: A DATA INPUT applied to working memory: Rete/NetworkTtl.idr's apply on the swept net, with the stamps beside.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_6__input_timed_projects
idris.note: The event's application is Rete/NetworkTtl.idr's, by projection.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_assert_just
idris.note: An assert that changes working memory on FireLoopTms is the assert, one propagation, then the cascade.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_assert_nothing
idris.note: A no-op assert on FireLoopTms touches nothing.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_retract_just
idris.note: A retraction of a live id on FireLoopTms is the removal, one propagation, then the cascade.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_retract_nothing
idris.note: A retraction of an id not live touches nothing on FireLoopTms.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_tms_net
idris.note: Apply the event to the network, propagate through it, and run the cascade the ended activations demand; a no-op assert and a retraction of an id not live touch nothing.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_tms_net_assert_just
idris.note: An assert that changes working memory is the network's assert, then the cascade.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_tms_net_assert_nothing
idris.note: A no-op assert on the network touches nothing.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_tms_net_retract_just
idris.note: A retraction of a live id is the network's retract, then the cascade.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_tms_net_retract_nothing
idris.note: A retraction of an id not live touches nothing on the network.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__apply_tms_agree
idris.note: AN INPUT AGREES: a no-op assert or a retraction of an id not live touches neither side; otherwise the network's assert or retract and FireLoop's assert-then-propagate or retract-then-propagate agree, and the cascades after them agree.

idris.name: iret_19_1__assert_state
idris.note: FireLoop's assert under the kind's lifecycle, then one propagation when working memory changed: what the Emit action and the asserted input both do, named so that a statement can mention it.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_plain_assert
idris.note: An asserted input is the named assert-then-propagate with nothing to avoid.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__apply_agree
idris.note: AN INPUT AGREES: the network's assert or retract and FireLoop's plain apply -- the same decision under the kind's lifecycle, then one propagation -- keep the agreement.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_plain
idris.note: An input applied to a FireLoop state without the TMS phase: the assert under the kind's lifecycle, or the retraction by id, then one propagation. What Rete/PumpBoundary.idr's apply does before its phase, and what Rete/Network.idr does.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_plain_well
idris.note: An input applied keeps the state well-formed.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_ttl_net
idris.note: A data event on the network; an adapter assert mints its deadline at the clock.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__apply_ttl_agree
idris.note: A DATA EVENT AGREES, the adapter assert's deadline included.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_4__apply_sampled
idris.note: The clause's apply, with the stamps updated beside it at the held sample. The definition follows the clause.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply
idris.note: Apply the event to working memory, propagate, and run the cascade the ended activations demand [IRET.12.2]. An adapter assert has no bound ids to avoid; a retraction of an id not live is a no-op. TTL updates are not modelled.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_inv
idris.note: Applying an event keeps the run invariant and the kinds of the rows' targets.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__is_live_inv
idris.note: And a live id belongs to a live fact.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__is_live_of
idris.note: `is_live` holds of a live fact's id.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__lookup_elem
idris.note: What a lookup returns is live and carries the id.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__lookup_some
idris.note: A live fact's id looks up to some live fact.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__is_live_sub
idris.note: Not live in a working memory, not live in any part of it.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_ttl
idris.note: Apply a data event: the engine's application of Rete/PumpBoundary.idr, and an adapter assert stamps the fresh id at the clock.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_ttl_inv
idris.note: Applying a data event keeps the clocked invariant and the clock: the assert is a mint of the fresh id followed by an external cascade; the retraction only removes.
